name: Nela Riehl - § 5 - Am 20
title: REPORT on the European Semester for economic policy coordination: employment and social priorities – annual report 2026
part_text: 5. Reiterates its call for Member States to allocate an adequate portion of their allocated ESF+ funds to fighting child poverty and promoting children’s well-being, with particular attention paid to Member States where child poverty levels exceed the EU average; recalls that combating poverty primarily falls within the responsibility of national family and social policies;
